name: progress-bar
description: Live progress bars in the status line and a docked Status panel for subagents and long jobs that write ~/.claude-progress/<slug>.json

statusLine.title: Progress status line
statusLine.description: Show the progress bars in the status line with no setup. A status line you already had still prints below them.

openPanel.title: Open the Status panel
openPanel.description: Open the Status panel beside the chat at session start, until /progress-bar panel off.

usageMeter.title: Usage meter
usageMeter.description: Show your plan usage (7-day percent) in the Status panel. To read it, one session per machine runs a tiny Claude Haiku call (claude -p) every 30 minutes on your login, which counts toward your usage.

hideEmails.title: Hide account emails
hideEmails.description: Mask account emails in the status line, the Status panel and the Chrome line, for screen sharing.
